name: Flaith

attributes.attribute: the Irish name for the goddesses of sovereignty
has its full account under its own entry

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Flaith, written Flaithius as well, is the name the Irish used for the goddesses of sovereignty. The full account of this figure stands in the entry on Sovereignty.

okr.objective: Flaith is a cross-reference to the goddesses of sovereignty.
key_results: The name points to the goddesses of sovereignty.
The full account stands under the entry Sovereignty.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
